entries.grid: sideways scroll-snap film strip (stills + shu/tokiwa intertitle cards); Programme page = 4-column contact sheet; asymmetric 5/7 ticket stub; 7/5 journal

entries.nav: H11 formal top header: small hanging koubai tag with a decorative kanji + horizontal wordmark top left, six menu items in a horizontal row numbered 01-06, account + cart; menu on its own row on tablets; indigo overlay with large numbered lines under 600 px; never fixed, no side rail
entries.hero: large horizontal Kaisei Opti headline on washi (cols 4-9) beside a framed hand-tinted etching laid over an edo-murasaki field (outline kanji, koubai sun); the season line stands vertically in the blank left margin column; lead + buttons under a rule
entries.grid: asymmetric 12-column paper grid with a blank 2-column left margin carrying only the section numbers 01-06; content in 10 columns: horizontal title + ruled filter table + three-unequal-column masonry hat shelf (5/4/3.5) with the count vertical in the margin; matcha band with text left and the four shapes as a ruled list right; 4/5 picture-text offset; indigo band with a picture rising over its edge; ruled journal index under a horizontal title
entries.illustration: hand-tinted copperplate etching (indigo + koubai washes; vermilion hue-shifted to koubai)
entries.accent: koubai #E16B8C for the hanging tag, shape seal, label squares, rules, hover fills and the footer wordmark; deep koubai #A8325A for numerals on washi; no vermilion/orange
entries.contrast: murasaki on washi 5.32, murasaki on kinari 4.73, gofun on murasaki 5.76, gofun on ai 6.68, pale ai on ai 4.70, sumi on matcha 9.39, ai on matcha 3.90 (large only), sumi on koubai 5.42, koubai on shikon 4.95 (large wordmark), deep koubai on washi 5.60, gofun on shikon 14.67, fuji #C9B8DD on shikon 8.44, sumi on washi 14.85, nezumi on washi 6.75
entries.breakFrame: true: transparent cut-out etching of a wide-brim hat with a tape measure rises out of the matcha shapes band over the hat shelf above (home); the fit etching also rises over the indigo band edge
entries.from: 1.0.0 H12/F3/L14, felt blush + mauve, Della Respira + Sen, layered paper-cut
entries.source: redesign PR (user feedback 2026-10-15: ugly, same layout as Yoru/Asagao, dull colours; main colour moved off vermilion because Asagao 1.1.0 took shu + sumi); corrected before release in #79 (user: drop shu, differentiate layout from Yoru 1.1.0 tategaki + right side rail)

entries.nav: H11: top band on every width (wordmark + tagline, Order a box CTA, account, cart); from 1100 px the menu alone hangs down a fixed right rail as vertical-rl columns read right to left (rail clamp(10.75rem, 8.25rem + 4vw, 13rem), padding clamp(1.25rem, .5rem + 1.25vw, 1.75rem), column gap clamp(1rem, .25rem + 1.25vw, 1.375rem), flex-wrap into tiers with clamp(2rem, 1rem + 1.6vw, 2.75rem) between them, overflow-y auto); 600-1099 px menu on its own ruled line under the bar; overlay on phones (long titles wrap, icon-only Menu under 480 px)
entries.illustration: maki-e lacquer (gold and yamabuki lacquer on navy)
entries.note: user feedback: right-rail menu items too cramped (1.1.0: 9.5rem rail, .5rem gaps, items touching both rail edges, nowrap so extra items spilled over the hero)

entries.archetype: asymmetric night page (horizontal Latin); tategaki only for CJK content
entries.nav: H11: top band on every width (wordmark + tagline, Order a box CTA, account, cart); from 1100 px the menu sits in a fixed right rail as a stacked list of horizontal items (small spaced caps, decimal-leading-zero numerals, hairline rules, yamabuki dot on the current page; rail clamp(13.5rem, 7rem + 9vw, 17rem), labels wrap, overflow-y auto); 600-1099 px menu on its own ruled line under the bar; overlay with horizontal items on phones. CJK content (:lang(ja/zh/ko)) restores the 1.1.1 vertical-rl columns.
entries.hero: large horizontal title top left, tall maki-e picture offset low on the right, lead and buttons under the title (vertical title at the right edge for CJK)
entries.grid: section titles in a right-hand column behind a hairline spine with 01/02 numerals; staggered tall product strips with horizontal names; origins in ruled columns; steps 01-03 stepping down left to right; journal in three ruled columns (all vertical for CJK)
entries.illustration: maki-e lacquer (gold and yamabuki lacquer on navy)
entries.note: user decision 2026-10-15: English must never be set vertically (no writing-mode vertical-* on Latin, no text-orientation upright); vertical writing only under :is(:lang(ja), :lang(zh), :lang(ko)). Theme files stay English-only (check-themes CJK rule unchanged).

entries.grid: 2x2 rooms grid beside a plum field
12-column card mosaic: big ultramarine title card beside class and note cards
poster rows: tall kincha vertical banner beside giant type, the bill as full-width ruled rows
one 680px reading column with numbered chapters, full-width sumi-ink plates on offset moegi blocks, a four-cell editions grid

a 4-column hairline product grid hero (headline cell 2x2, five photo cells, a spin strip), magazine contents with page numbers, a 6/6 feature spread with two text columns and a pull quote, a four-card toy shelf
a 5/6 hero with three pencil sketches stacked and rotated as a collage, a 4-column CSS-columns masonry of herb tiles with an offset second column, a 7/5 consultation band with steps and a fees card

a full-bleed centred giant-type hero over a paper-cut illustration with a vertical label at the right edge, then a 1/1 sticky-media story (pinned picture left, numbered steps scrolling right), a 4-column product grid

a text-left / art-right matcha hero (isometric workshop framed on a kokeshi pattern panel, cut-out kokeshi breaking the frame and the hero edge), then a single 40rem reading column with four numbered chapters, a matcha pull quote and inline plates, a 2-up product grid at reading width

an app shell under the full top header: a 300px night-indigo sidebar with the synced camp board beside the page column; azalea-pink scene-map hero (framed watercolour site map with numbered pins, cut-out bell tent breaking the frame and the hero edge), a staggered 2x2 stays grid, a pink azalea band, a night timeline band with a cut-out lantern over its top edge, 3-up journal

full top header with the menu as a fixed indigo side rail from 1100px; yamabuki diagonal-split hero (pattern-textured field beside the flat studio illustration, cut-out figure across the seam and the hero edge), indigo studio board strip, classes in an asymmetric 7/5 masonry with the right column dropped, yamabuki method band with a cut-out ring over its top edge, four first-visit cards, 3-up journal

formal top bar (name + tagline, one-row menu, Reserve pill); split-screen hero: kikyo field with the headline beside a paper wall with the garden framed as an open shoji window, cut-out bellflower sweet breaking out of the frame across the seam; night-ink tea house board strip; menu as a split screen (kikyo panel left, 2x2 dishes right); split calendar band (ink | kikyo) with a cut-out matcha bowl over its top edge; four first-visit cards; 3-up journal; split kikyo/wisteria page heads with the sweet on the seam

formal white top bar (name, account, cart, Shop pill); fixed seiheki side rail from 1100 px (label, numbered menu, hours; vertical line in zh/ja); seiheki scene-map hero: headline + white card beside an isometric workshop map with five numbered pins and a legend, cut-out bowl breaking the map frame, cut-out jubako over the hero bottom edge; workshop board as status cards; shelf, stages and notes as white app panels on celadon; seiheki drying-room band with a second jubako breaking out of the framed cabinet; seiheki page heads with the bowl over the bottom edge

formal paper top header with the menu split three left / two right of the centred office name and a charcoal Book a free first talk button (overlay menu below 1280 px); keshizumi diagonal-split hero with the abacus pattern multiplied in beside the 2D flat office, cut-out abacus on a ledger across the seam and over the bottom edge; office board strip; sticky-media services (charcoal column with title + adviser picture sticks while four service cards scroll); tax calendar band with diagonal ink seam and a cut-out seal; four-step strip; journal on the lightened pattern; diagonal page heads

formal paper header with the race name centred on the top row, Enter a team button at the right end and the menu centred on its own row beneath (overlay menu below 1100 px); konpeki text half on the left with the brush pattern multiplied in, framed sumi-ink handover painting on the right, cut-out runner breaking out of the frame over the field and the hero bottom edge; race board as one ink band; the course legs as a sideways-scrolling strip of cards on a konpeki band; sash band with giant 42 and a cut-out sash; race-day four-step strip (scrolls sideways on narrow screens); journal on the lightened pattern; full konpeki page heads with the runner over the bottom edge
